environment: automated (Environment A, real file-backed SQLite, real BSB dataset)
method: A realistic 4-segment sermon transcript is fed sequentially (never batched) through the exact pure cores the frontend Service Replay scheduler calls per segment: handle_final_transcript (Bible Suggestion path), sermon::analyze_and_queue (Sermon Finding path), and a standalone BibleIntelligenceEngine.analyze (Bible Finding path) - each against the real, complete BSB dataset (66 books / 1,189 chapters / 31,086 verses). After the loop, content_intelligence::analyze_and_queue and cross_domain::analyze_and_queue are run once, mirroring the operator clicking 'Analyze Cross-Domain + Content' after replay completes. One resulting Bible suggestion (John 3:16) is then approved and carried through prepare/activate/stop. The real on-disk SQLite file is then closed and reopened.
verified: transcript sequence numbers strictly increase across all 4 segments - proof of genuine sequential (not batched/simultaneous) processing
all 4 segments persisted exactly once via the Suggestion path
the real Sermon Intelligence engine produced at least one finding from the realistic transcript
the real Bible Finding path produced at least one finding (John 3:16 / Romans 8:28) from the real BSB dataset

Content Intelligence and Cross-Domain analysis both executed successfully against the accumulated findings (their actual output count is logged, never hard-asserted - honesty rule: never fabricate a correlation/candidate the real deterministic engines did not genuinely produce)
the approved John 3:16 suggestion, its presentation item (Prepared -> Active -> Stopped), and the ended service all survive closing and reopening the real on-disk database file

no stale replay state exists after restart - by construction, since Service Replay's own scheduler (segment position/pause/speed) lives entirely in frontend memory and never touches the database at all
limitations: Environment A only - real Windows human-operator Service Replay usage (Environment C) not performed this phase. This test proves the offline end-to-end intelligence workflow; it does NOT prove microphone hardware, CPAL hardware capture, Whisper real-world latency, or physical audio quality, per spec section 33's explicit category separation.
